title: Write the guide content
body:
We need a very good guide for react-instantsearch that will explain basic and advanced concepts.

Parts that need to be written:
- [ ] Introduction (what's react instantsearch)
- [ ] Widgets (connected widgets to Algolia)
- [ ] Connectors (HOC providing simple mechanism for controlling rendering)
- [ ] Preselecting values (VirtualWidgets)
- [ ] Configuring Algolia parameters (distinct use case)
- [ ] Wrapping 3rd party libraries
- [ ] Styling (CSS Class names only)
- [ ] Creating a custom menu with manual items (#1062) 
- [ ] Conditionally displaying widgets
- [ ] Url synchronisation (Only show it can be activated/deactivated)

We should leave out parts like creating your own widget, injecting state, passing a history etc. for now because those APIs are unstable and may well change in the future.

comments.body:
What do you think of a structure like this ? 
1. Introduction
   - what's react-instantsearch
   - purposes of widgets
   - purposes of connectors
2. Styling
3. Connectors
   - How to use connectors (half the part that already exists in making your own widget)
4. Wrapping 3rd party libraries
5. Create your own widget
   - create connector api (used for conditional display)
6. Conditionally displaying widgets
7. FAQ
   - How to preselect values (virtual widgets)
   - How to add manual values to a Menu/RefinementList...
   - How to synchronize the url (this link being referenced within the InstantSearch component doc)

Also, do we want to keep the intro page for connectors/components?

It's taking shape! Some suggestions:
~~purposes of~~ widgets
~~purposes of~~ connectors (user do not yet know about them, will not ask their purposes)
~~Wrapping~~ 3rd party UI libraries
~~FAQ~~ Advanced topics

Some part have been done. Feedback are needed :)
we still miss: Configuring Algolia parameters (distinct use case)
